notes: Every source morpheme and target token is partitioned once; the assimilated article (s002) takes the written *the* under rule 12.
The final italic *me* is `added`: the second verb carries no object suffix, so no morpheme licenses it (rule 44); the italic corroborates and does not decide (rule 7).
`מְנַצֵּחַ` → *Chief Musician* heads on *Chief*, which carries the נצח lexeme; heading on *Musician* is the named competing reading (rules 31, 8).
